name: Shoulder Shrugs

instructions.description: Sit or stand upright in a comfortable position with your feet stable and your arms relaxed by your sides. Keep your head and neck neutral.
Slowly lift both shoulders straight up toward your ears while keeping your arms relaxed. Pause briefly at the top without creating tension in your neck.
Slowly lower your shoulders back down and let them relax fully. Focus on releasing tension as the shoulders move downward.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, keeping the motion smooth and controlled.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the duration of the comfortable, controlled practice.

commentsNotes: Move the shoulders straight up and down.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pushing your head forward.
Do not force the shoulders higher than is comfortable.
Focus on relaxing the shoulders as you lower them.
